character.description: The same distinct stocky middle-aged Vietnamese prep cook from kitchen-prep-staff-v2: broad round face, neat salt-and-pepper moustache, tall white chef toque, white double-breasted chef jacket, paprika-red apron, charcoal trousers and dark kitchen clogs; three-quarter side view facing screen-left toward the existing prep board. Keep him clearly different from the young player-owner.

chop_vegetables.action: Four-frame seamless vegetable-prep loop at the existing left cutting board. Keep exact same identity, side-left facing, uniform, full-body scale and feet pivot. Hold a broad rectangular stainless-steel chef's cleaver with a sturdy wooden handle; the blade should be clearly larger than his palm and read as a real kitchen cleaver, not a small narrow knife. Show the elbow lifting, a decisive controlled chop toward waist-height, a visible wrist rebound and return to the opening pose. Feet remain planted; small shoulder and apron response only. Do not draw a replacement table, board, kitchen, plate, food pile, other person or shadow; the game map supplies the board and the separate transparent chopped-vegetables overlay supplies cut produce while this row plays. Flat magenta background.

style: Polished painted 2D chibi game art matching the existing Banh Mi Pho staff and player characters, warm natural shading, clean dark outline, expressive face; not pixel art.
